```sh
kafka group remove-members <groupId>
```

Remove one or more static members from a consumer group's session

## Arguments

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `groupId` | group id    |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Removes the specified member identities; consumer membership determines the resulting assignment.

## Before you run

Evicts group members and triggers reassignment. Coordinate with the application to avoid unexpected rebalances and duplicate external side effects.

## Flags

| Flag                             | Description                                                                                |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--brokers <string>`             | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                                           |
| `--yes`                          | confirm the removal without an interactive prompt                                          |
| `--member <string> (repeatable)` | member to remove, memberId or memberId:groupInstanceId (repeatable; at least one required) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka group remove-members my-group --member consumer-1-abc --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "members": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
